note: Literature confirms heterozygous carriers of recessive NOTCH3 loss-of-function variants are predominantly asymptomatic without premature stroke.

evidence.text: Systematic evaluation of biallelic NOTCH3 variants found that monoallelic carriers of loss-of-function variants are predominantly asymptomatic, with only rare reports of nonspecific headaches.

source.title: Clinical and neuroradiological spectrum of biallelic variants in NOTCH3
source.quote: Notably, monoallelic carriers of loss-of-function variants are predominantly asymptomatic, with only a few cases reporting nonspecific headaches.

numbers.metric: total patients with biallelic variants analyzed

evidence.text: Biallelic null NOTCH3 variants exhibit an autosomal recessive inheritance pattern distinct from CADASIL, with heterozygous carrier parents and incidental heterozygous carriers presenting without premature stroke.

source.title: Distinct neurological phenotypes associated with biallelic loss of NOTCH3 function: evidence for recessive inheritance
source.quote: The consanguineous parents were confirmed as heterozygous variant carriers. In addition, three heterozygous NOTCH3 null variants were reported as incidental findings in three unrelated cases analyzed in our center.
